name: Ripe Peeled Nectarine or White Peach (Skin Removed)
whyItWorks: When fully ripe and thoroughly peeled, nectarines and white peaches provide soft, sweet soluble pectin that digests effortlessly. Removing the fuzzy or waxy peel eliminates the harsh insoluble fiber.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Wait until the fruit yields softly to gentle thumb pressure. Use a sharp paring knife to slice off all skin before eating.
watchOuts: Never eat with the skin on during active disease. Avoid rock-hard unripened fruit.
